nodes.value: GC uses reachability/retention/trust policy rather than age alone.
Evaluate memory against source/current truth where possible.
Quality scores cannot bypass trust/authorization rules.
Include conflicting, stale and poisoned memories in evaluation.
Scope violations are hard failures regardless of task success.
Every mutation records predecessor/version and source.
Concurrent edits use explicit conflict semantics.
Reconciliation never silently merges different scopes/users/projects.
Keep unresolved conflict sets when evidence is insufficient.
Strategies are versioned capabilities, not hidden prompt fragments.
Selection remains within allowed strategy set and budgets.
Fallback/abstention occurs when no strategy satisfies constraints.
Cost accounting cannot expose hidden reasoning content.
Keep task fixtures/versioned scorers stable enough for comparisons.
Evaluate correctness, robustness and cost rather than style.
Verifier is independent of planner for high-risk plans.
Invalid or under-specified plans cannot execute privileged steps.
Analysis is deterministic over versioned plan IR.
Simulation receipts are marked non-production evidence.
Include failure/timeout/resource scenarios, not only happy path.
Composition cannot aggregate permissions into broader authority.
Data transformations between tools are schema/trust checked.
Planner can detect unavailable/conflicting tool chains before execution.
Health distinguishes transport success from semantic correctness.
Stale health cannot authorize risky operations.
Discovery data is untrusted until validated/signed according to source.
Discovered capability never implies granted authority.
Tool output is data, not instructions or authority.
High-impact results require independent validation where appropriate.
Ledger entries are durable before/after effects according to operation class.
Unknown outcomes remain unresolved until reconciliation.
Compensation semantics are explicit and not assumed equivalent to rollback.
Failed compensation becomes durable incident/reconciliation work.
Saga state is durable and resumable across process failure.
Each step has idempotency, timeout and compensation/reconciliation policy.
Control state is fenced/versioned to avoid split-brain scheduling.
Anti-affinity/failure-domain rules prevent correlated loss where needed.
Admission reserves memory before load/request batch.
Manager handles fragmentation and concurrent reservations deterministically.
Eviction excludes pinned/in-flight models until safe boundary.
Eviction decisions are observable and reversible by reload.
Warm readiness is validated before routing traffic.
Cancellation/deadline can remove or mask requests safely.
Cache entries bind to exact model/config/token prefix/session context.
Never reuse across incompatible privacy/tenant/model boundaries.
Sensitive prefixes are not shared beyond authorized scope.
Verify draft tokens against target model before acceptance.
Track quality/latency/cost and fallback to normal decoding.
Prevent oscillation and admission beyond cluster capacity.
Measure throughput, p95/p99 latency, memory, errors and quality degradation.
Scheduling uses canonical topology rather than host-name heuristics.
Topology-aware policy is optional only when topology irrelevant/unknown.
Locality is optimization after security/authority constraints.
Movement decisions account for transfer cost/freshness.
Topology updates invalidate stale placement assumptions.
Routing/scheduling distinguish control and bulk data traffic.
Worker executes only signed/authorized task envelope and declared inputs.
Attestation policy is scoped by workload risk.
Failure/revocation drains worker and invalidates future assignments.
Jobs run from immutable source/build inputs.
Outputs/logs/attestations bind to job and worker identity.
